title: boehmeria nivea var. tenacissima
intro: Boehmeria nivea var. tenacissima, commonly known as Duan Wood or White Mulberry, is a plant species that belongs to the Urticaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Duan Wood include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
